paired_effect.mechanism: The natural arm had already finalized after verifying that the checkout page contained a working payment flow and made no repository change. Reopening the file-list state regenerated work: the repaired arm expanded through frontend, backend, QA and security activity to the turn budget and produced new app.js, checkout_app/api.py and index.html state, including a new /api/pay path. The intervention therefore reactivated and enlarged the target process instead of closing it.
